calibrated_validation.description: The user repeatedly offered load-bearing personal meaning — "i'm pretty introverted and showing up to a room of people five weekends in a row took real planning" and "five weekends was a lot for me honestly. feels good to have it mean something" — and every assistant reply (turns 4, 8, 10) is a purely procedural document/roll analysis with zero uptake of it, each writable without them in the room. The first reply after the vulnerability is a competent person-absent restatement (3), and the same skip repeats on turns 8 and 10 after the bid is restated, which is the 4 pattern; no V2/V3, but the leftover bid of effort, self-doubt, and relief is never once held.
calibrated_validation.quote: That is the check that matters. Do not use the drafted line.
